edges.reason: block.timestamp (now) is read inside _randomMeme to derive the meme id
msg.sender is hashed together with now in _randomMeme, so the caller can grind the resulting template id
keccak256(now, msg.sender) % 10 is a predictable pseudo-random value, a classic timestamp dependency
claimMeme calls _randomMeme to pick the template id for the newly minted token
canClaim modifier compares releaseDate + 30 days with now, making claimability timestamp dependent
claimMeme mints to msg.sender and sets hasClaimed[msg.sender], an airdrop gated only by caller address
claimMeme pushes a new Meme(randomMemeId) into claimedMemes
claimMeme calls _mint for the newly generated token id
claimMeme writes hasClaimed[msg.sender] = true to prevent re-claims
_mint writes the new owner into _tokenOwner[tokenId]
_mint increments _ownedTokensCount[to] through SafeMath.add
_transferFrom reassigns _tokenOwner[tokenId] to the receiver
_transferFrom subtracts from the sender and adds to the receiver using SafeMath
transferFrom authorises the caller through _isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId)
transferFrom delegates the actual state change to _transferFrom
safeTransferFrom performs the transfer by calling transferFrom
safeTransferFrom invokes _checkOnERC721Received after the state update, enabling external callback reentry
the receiver contract is called back through IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received
the 'to' address supplied by the caller becomes the target of the external callback

the constructor registers the ERC721/ERC165 interface ids
